cap:info.cap:headline: Heavy Rainfall Warning for Rangpur, Mymensingh and Sylhet Divisions
cap:info.cap:description: The formation of thunderclouds is likely and it may continue over the country. Heavy (44-88 mm/24hrs) to very heavy (>88 mm/24hrs) rainfall is likely to occur at places over Rangpur, Mymensingh and Sylhet divisions during next 72 hours commencing 06 PM of 13.05.2026. Due to heavy to very heavy rainfall, temporary waterlogging at places over Sylhet division.
cap:info.cap:instruction: Residents in low-lying areas of Sylhet division should take precautionary measures against temporary waterlogging.
